about: Gas and fluid supply, control and monitoring: setpoint (unit decides flow / mass flow / pressure / temperature), start, stop, select, dispense, read, zero, calibrate, vent, status. power, open/close, ack, estop come from the shared layer.

secondary.inert_purelab_he_2gb: glovebox: box pressure set point and gas purification on/off (enclosure primary)

not_mapped.inert_puresolvmd: thin class: manual valves per column, no set point or measurement
not_mapped.vaisala_dmt152: thin class: a transmitter with one measurement query (its result is the shared `result`)

flow.label: mass flow (standard)
notes: flows are standard flows (sccm, slpm) at the controller's reference conditions (25 C, 1 atm by default)

pressure.label: pressure (gauge)

then.step: switch the controller to automatic pressure control

notes: the controller regulates the gauge pressure upstream of it (back-pressure); setpoint switches it to automatic control

setpoint.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

zero.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

unsupported.start: a continuous controller: it acts whenever it has a set point (`setpoint`; a set point of 0 stops the flow)
unsupported.stop: a continuous controller: it acts whenever it has a set point (`setpoint`; a set point of 0 stops the flow); switch to manual valve control with `chemlab call INST control.set_mode --mode manual`
unsupported.select: a single gas line (no gas table or valve positions)
unsupported.dispense: a gas device: it does not dispense liquid volumes
unsupported.calibrate: no span / reference calibration from the computer (the sensor zero is `zero`)
unsupported.vent: no vent valve: lower the set point to let the upstream pressure down

alternatives.start: give a set point: `chemlab run INST setpoint 3bar` (it then regulates in automatic mode).

setpoint: pressure set points are gauge pressure (1 to 5 bar g on this controller)
when the controller is in manual / valve-steering mode, setpoint also switches it to automatic control (control.set_mode)

setpoint:mass_flow.message: the bleed of {inst} is open, so it takes no liquid flow.
setpoint:mass_flow.fix: close it first: `chemlab run {inst} vent off`.

vent.message: the liquid set point of {inst} is not zero; the bleed is opened only without liquid flow.

unsupported.start: a continuous controller: it acts whenever it has a set point (`setpoint`; a set point of 0 stops the flow)
unsupported.stop: a continuous controller: it acts whenever it has a set point (`setpoint`; a set point of 0 stops the flow)
unsupported.dispense: it evaporates a liquid flow into the gas (`setpoint 12g/h`); it does not dispense volumes
unsupported.select: the carrier gas is the one plumbed to its inlet (declared by the lab operator)

alternatives.select: an operator declares the connected gas with `chemlab call INST supply.connect_gas --gas nitrogen --pressure_pa 400000`.

setpoint: a flow (500sccm, 1slpm) sets the carrier gas, a mass flow (12g/h) the liquid, a temperature (140C) the mixer
set points above the controller's full scale (`status`) are refused
vent: vent opens the bleed screw; it needs the liquid set point at 0 first

dispense: dispense sets the volume (and --rate), starts and returns job-N; `chemlab wait job-N` or --wait blocks until it is delivered
calibrate: `calibrate start` dispenses the nominal calibration volume; weigh it, then `calibrate enter measured=0.98L`; `calibrate cancel` aborts

start.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.
start.label: power on

start.message: {inst} is still warming up (converter and detector).
start.fix: wait until it is ready (`chemlab run {inst} status`; about 15 min after switching on).
start.label: warmed up

zero.message: the inlet of {inst} is on {value}, not on zero gas.
zero.fix: connect zero gas first: `chemlab run {inst} select zero_air`, wait until the reading is steady, then zero.
zero.label: zero gas on the inlet

calibrate.message: the inlet of {inst} is on {value}, not on a span gas standard.
calibrate.fix: connect the span standard first (`chemlab run {inst} select srm_2631a`), wait until the reading is steady, then calibrate.
calibrate.label: span gas on the inlet

calibrate.message: the reading of {inst} is over its measuring range, so the span would be wrong.
calibrate.fix: select a higher range first (`chemlab call {inst} range.select --index 3`), wait until the reading is steady, then calibrate.
calibrate.label: reading within the range

unsupported.setpoint: an analyzer: no set point (its range is `chemlab call INST range.select`)
unsupported.dispense: a gas device: it does not dispense liquid volumes

select: select connects a calibration gas standard to the inlet (zero_air, zero_nitrogen, srm_...); `select sample` goes back to the sample inlet
zero: zero needs zero gas on the inlet (select zero_air) and a steady reading; it returns job-N
calibrate: calibrate runs the span with the standard on the inlet; span=VALUE (e.g. span=2954ppm, the certificate value) is set first; returns job-N
